notes: Moves production machine configuration and calibration data to one checkout-independent external machine-data store, preventing a new checkout or worktree from silently seeding tracked starter locations.

Adds a fail-closed first-start migration for v1.2.0-rc.6, v1.2.0, and v1.3.0-rc.1 machines with explicit candidate review, verified backup and copy evidence, machine identity confirmation, preset-like Camera warnings, and per-target authorization before normal application construction.
Adds immutable configuration history and exact restoration for named locations, rack pairs, four-corner plate calibrations, Settings, obstacles, and regulator profiles.

Adds guarded configuration previews with exact coordinate deltas, policy-driven confirmation strength, hard-invalid rejection, and Controller enforcement that prevents unverified or revoked saved targets from dispatching motion.

Adds external update-preservation transactions, verified pre-change backups, exact post-update protected-byte checks, deployment anchors, receipt-gated relaunch, and support-guided exact-profile rollback to reviewed legacy releases.

The bundled firmware artifact is byte-identical to v1.3.0-rc.1 (SHA-256 EDA070CE734D5167F0795FAF30DF461C8A07341E09CA698DE9D850315B0D5884). Machines updating from v1.2.0-rc.6 or v1.2.0 must install the required v1.3 firmware; v1.3.0-rc.1 machines must verify matching provenance or redeploy it. The application updater does not flash firmware automatically.

requires_firmware.note: Use the v1.3 firmware artifact bundled with this release. It is byte-identical to v1.3.0-rc.1; direct v1.2.0-rc.6/v1.2.0 upgrades still require deployment, while v1.3.0-rc.1 upgrades require verified matching provenance or redeployment.
